entities.summary: Gregory Lee Haugen was an American professional boxer from 1982 to 1999. He was a world champion in two weight classes, having held the International Boxing Federation (IBF) lightweight title twice between 1986 and 1989 and the World Boxing Organization (WBO) light welterweight title in 1991.
